parsed.post: Round 9: WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 was a great win: 0.9199 -> 0.9098! Keeping it. Regularization significantly improves generalization. For the final round, I'll retry MATRIX_LR=0.10. The added weight decay might provide enough stability to benefit from the higher learning rate that previously caused a regression.
